findings.evidence: NEVER align columns with tabs: viewers use different tab stops, so columns drift. Use spaces.
findings.fix: Keep the useful formatting constraints concise and add design-specific decision guidance grounded in observed wireframe failures; record any removal of instructions the model reliably produces unprompted.
Supplement the formatting warnings with a concrete UI-mockup failure and its consequence, such as showing an error solely through color when the ASCII handoff must communicate it in text.

findings.evidence: questions in steps 1 and 5 end the run ... If the user rejects all, ask which ranked task each option got wrong, then redraw.
findings.fix: State that the agent returns the rejection question to the caller and redraws on a subsequent invocation with the user's answer, or redraws immediately only when that feedback is already available.

findings.evidence: Default to 3 structurally distinct mockups (not restyles of one layout) ... draw the third by varying the other axis (density or navigation) on the best-fit structure.
findings.fix: Clarify that the third alternative may deliberately reuse a structure when the task branch yields fewer than three viable structures, and identify the substantive trade-off it must demonstrate.
